verdict.rationale: Yapily is an open banking API, so a background-automation capability is a fair question, but the evidence pack documents no user-configurable automations, workflows, or agents that run autonomously. Scheduled, periodic and variable recurring payments are payment types executed per payment instruction, not general automations. Webhooks are outbound notifications, a developer building block rather than an automation engine. Both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: You can initiate single, scheduled and periodic payments using Yapily's Payments API.
Collect variable recurring payments without re-authorisation each time.
Webhooks allows you to receive real-time HTTP notifications of changes happening in the Yapily Platform.
